name: Vice Warden Morredh
desc:
Vice Warden Morredh is a Canor NPC. He is the crux of the Chainwarden obtainment process.

Being a Canor has afforded him more benefits than other non-Adret in [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority), earning him the position of Vice Warden, though he aspires to someday become more than just a _Vice_ Warden and replace [Warden Jericho](entity:warden_jericho) as the one in charge of the eastern world.
additional_info: -   Morredh's age is much more advanced than [Warden Jericho](entity:warden_jericho), suggesting he's far more likely to pass or retire than end up replacing him.
goals: Replace [Warden Jericho](entity:warden_jericho) as the one in charge of the eastern world
